questions.question: What is transpiration stream?
questions.answer: The upward movement of water in the xylem vessels is called transpiration stream.

questions.question: What is cohesion?
questions.answer: Due to forces of attraction, water molecules join together and drag themselves up in the xylem column.

questions.question: What is adhesion?
questions.answer: Adhesion is the force of attraction between xylem walls and water molecules. It causes capillary action and drags water upward.

questions.question: How does water reach the uppermost parts of plants?
questions.answer: Cohesion, adhesion and suction pressure develop a continuous column of water in the xylem vessel. As a result, water moves upward and reaches the uppermost parts of the plants.
